findings.title: Service-Level Wildcard (s3:*, dynamodb:*, sqs:*, secretsmanager:*) on '*' in ManagedPolicy:OverpermissiveDataWildcard
findings.description: Policy 'OverpermissiveDataWildcard' grants broad wildcard actions (s3:*, dynamodb:*, sqs:*, secretsmanager:*) across all resources ('*') in ManagedPolicy:OverpermissiveDataWildcard.
findings.remediation: Scope actions to exact API calls and restrict Resource ARNs to specific buckets, tables, or roles.

findings.title: Full AdministratorAccess Managed Policy attached to Role 'LambdaAdminExecRole'
findings.description: Role 'LambdaAdminExecRole' has AWS-managed 'AdministratorAccess' attached, granting unrestricted full administrative control across all AWS resources.
findings.remediation: Replace AdministratorAccess with scoped least-privilege policies derived from CloudTrail.

findings.title: Service-Level Wildcard (s3:*, iam:*) on '*' in InlinePolicy:VendorFullS3AndIAM
findings.description: Role 'LegacyVendorCrossAccountRole' grants broad wildcard actions (s3:*, iam:*) across all resources ('*') in InlinePolicy:VendorFullS3AndIAM.
findings.remediation: Scope actions to exact API calls and restrict Resource ARNs to specific buckets, tables, or roles.

findings.title: Full Administrative Wildcard (*:*) in InlinePolicy:FullWildcard
findings.description: Role 'DeprecatedMigrationRole' grants Action '*' on Resource '*' via InlinePolicy:FullWildcard, providing unrestricted administrative control across all AWS services.
findings.remediation: Replace '*' actions and resources with scoped service-level permissions generated from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: Stale IAM Role Inactive for 227 Days
findings.description: Role 'LegacyVendorCrossAccountRole' has not been assumed for 227 days (threshold: 90 days).

findings.title: Dormant IAM Role Never Used (326 days old)
findings.description: Role 'DeprecatedMigrationRole' was created 326 days ago and has never been assumed.
findings.remediation: Detach policies and delete unused role 'DeprecatedMigrationRole' after owner verification.

findings.title: Stale Access Key (AKIAIOSFODNN7STALE01) Unused for 204 Days
findings.description: User 'ci-deploy-bot' has an active access key 'AKIAIOSFODNN7STALE01' last used 204 days ago (created 347 days ago).
findings.remediation: aws iam update-access-key --user-name ci-deploy-bot --access-key-id AKIAIOSFODNN7STALE01 --status Inactive

findings.title: Active Access Key (AKIAIOSFODNN7NEVER02) Never Used (161 days old)
findings.description: User 'junior-dev-alex' has an active access key 'AKIAIOSFODNN7NEVER02' created 161 days ago that has never been used.
findings.remediation: aws iam update-access-key --user-name junior-dev-alex --access-key-id AKIAIOSFODNN7NEVER02 --status Inactive

findings.title: Console User 'junior-dev-alex' Lacks Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
findings.description: IAM User 'junior-dev-alex' has an active console password login profile without any registered virtual or hardware MFA device.
findings.remediation: Enforce MFA via IAM condition 'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent' and enroll MFA for 'junior-dev-alex'.

findings.title: Console User 'helpdesk-support' Lacks Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
findings.description: IAM User 'helpdesk-support' has an active console password login profile without any registered virtual or hardware MFA device.
findings.remediation: Enforce MFA via IAM condition 'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent' and enroll MFA for 'helpdesk-support'.

findings.title: Unconstrained Cross-Account Trust on 'LegacyVendorCrossAccountRole'
findings.description: Role 'LegacyVendorCrossAccountRole' trusts external principal 'arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root' (especially broad ':root') without requiring 'sts:ExternalId' or 'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent' conditions.
findings.remediation: Add a Condition block requiring sts:ExternalId and scope Principal from ':root' to a specific role ARN.
findings.cis_benchmark: AWS Security Incident Response Guide - Confused Deputy

findings.title: Public Wildcard Principal ('*') in Trust Policy for 'DeprecatedMigrationRole'
findings.description: Role 'DeprecatedMigrationRole' allows ANY AWS account or principal ('*') to assume the role!
findings.remediation: Restrict AssumeRolePolicyDocument Principal to explicit trusted ARNs and require sts:ExternalId.
findings.cis_benchmark: AWS IAM Best Practices - Trust Policies

findings.title: Privilege Escalation Path to Admin via CreatePolicyVersion
findings.description: Principal 'User:ci-deploy-bot' can escalate to full administrative privileges through hop chain: User:ci-deploy-bot -> AWS_ACCOUNT_ADMIN using (iam:CreatePolicyVersion).
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:CreatePolicyVersion on 'User:ci-deploy-bot' with explicit resource ARNs and IAM Permissions Boundaries.
findings.cis_benchmark: MITRE ATT&CK Cloud T1078 / Rhino Security Labs IAM Escalation Matrix

findings.title: Privilege Escalation Path to Admin via PassRole+CreateFunction -> DirectAdminPolicy
findings.description: Principal 'User:junior-dev-alex' can escalate to full administrative privileges through hop chain: User:junior-dev-alex -> Role:LambdaAdminExecRole -> AWS_ACCOUNT_ADMIN using (iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction, *:*).
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction, *:* on 'User:junior-dev-alex' with explicit resource ARNs and IAM Permissions Boundaries.
findings.cis_benchmark: MITRE ATT&CK Cloud T1078 / Rhino Security Labs IAM Escalation Matrix

findings.description: Principal 'User:junior-dev-alex' can escalate to full administrative privileges through hop chain: User:junior-dev-alex -> Role:DeprecatedMigrationRole -> AWS_ACCOUNT_ADMIN using (iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction, *:*).
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:PassRole, lambda:CreateFunction, *:* on 'User:junior-dev-alex' with explicit resource ARNs and IAM Permissions Boundaries.
findings.cis_benchmark: MITRE ATT&CK Cloud T1078 / Rhino Security Labs IAM Escalation Matrix
